arabic text: Ya Rab Behhaqe Zehra, Taufiq Yeh Ata Ho\nMarney Sey Pehley Ya Rab Deedar-e-Karbala Ho
english translation text: O Lord, for the sake of Zahra, grant me this opportunity:\nbefore death, O Lord, may I behold Karbala

arabic text:
Jo Arz-e-Karbala Hai, Har Arz Sey Siva Hai
Iss Khaak-e-Karbala Pei, Sheh Ka Lahu Mila Hai
Har Ladawa Mariz Ki, Yeh Khaak Hi Dawa Ho
Marney Sey Pehley Ya Rab Deedar-e-Karbala Ho
english translation text:
The land of Karbala is greater than every other land;
the King's blood is mixed within the dust of Karbala.
For every incurable illness, may this dust become the cure.
Before death, O Lord, may I behold Karbala

arabic text:
Mein Bhi To Matami Hoon, Zakir Hun Seyyada
Ka
Nauha Parha Hai Mainey, Hum shakle Mustafa Ka
Iss Zakiri Ka Meri, Kismat Mei Yeh Sila Ho
Marney Sey Pehley Ya Rab Deedar-e-Karbala Ho
english translation text:
I too am a mourner, a reciter for
the Sayyida; I have recited the lament of
the likeness of Mustafa. May the reward for
this recitation be written in my destiny: before
death, O Lord, may I behold Karbala

arabic text:
Ya Rab Namaz-e-Shab Mei, Bass Yeh Dua Karun
Mein
Kuch Deyr Uss Zameen Par, Majliss Bapa Karun
Mein
Har Matami Key Lab Par, Har Dam Yehi Dua Ho
Marney Sey Pehley Ya Rab Deedar-e-Karbala Ho
english translation text:
O Lord, in the night prayer, let
me make only this supplication: allow me
for a little while to establish a
gathering upon that land. May this prayer
remain always upon every mourner's lips: before
death, O Lord, may I behold Karbala

arabic text:
Mazloomiyat Pei Jiski, Rota Hai Yeh Zamana
Uss Beykhata Key Dar Par, Ek Baar To hai Jana
Jo Qarz Hai Lahu Par, woh Iss Tarha Ada Ho
Marney Sey Pehley Ya Rab Deedar-e-Karbala Ho
english translation text:
The world weeps over the oppression of that innocent one;
let me visit his door at least once.
May the debt owed to his blood be repaid in this way:
before death, O Lord, may I behold Karbala

arabic text:
Wo Sar-Zameen Jahan Par, Gunji Azaan-e-Akbar
Tasbeeh Aansu'on Ki, Parhni hai Uss Zameen Par
Ik Sajda-e-Aqeedat, Uss Khaak Par Ada Hao
Marney Sey Pehley Ya Rab Deedar-e-Karbala Ho
english translation text:
That land where Akbar's adhan once echoed—
there I wish to recite a tasbih made of tears.
May I offer one prostration of devotion upon that dust:
before death, O Lord, may I behold Karbala

arabic text:
Nanhi se jis lahad mein, sote hai ab bhi asgher
Us par charhaunga me phoolon ki ek chadar
Pursa wahaan ho aisa pehle nahi huwa ho
Marne se pehle ya rab
english translation text:
At the tiny grave where Asghar still sleeps,
I will spread a sheet of flowers.
May such condolences be offered there as never before.
Before death, O Lord...

arabic text:
Jis khaak ki fazeelat kaaba se bhi siwa hia
Sajda hare k nabhi ne jis khaak par kiya hai
Sajda wahaan karu mein, Zahra ki gar ata ho
Marne se pehle ya rab
english translation text:
The virtue of that dust is greater even than the Kaaba;
every prophet has prostrated upon that soil.
May I prostrate there, should Zahra grant it.
Before death, O Lord...

arabic text:
Qurbaan Ho Gaya Jo, Kulsoom Ki Dua Par
Ro'zaa Mei-Uska Deykhun, Jo Margaya Wafa Par
Ghardey Sharaf Bhi Meri, Taqdeer Mei Likha Ho
Marney Sey Pehley Ya Rab Deedar-e-Karbala Ho
english translation text:
He who sacrificed himself upon Kulsum's prayer—
may I behold the shrine of the one who died for loyalty.
May the honour of serving his court also be written in my destiny:
before death, O Lord, may I behold Karbala
